people.text: Matthew wants to learn about the history of the city in a fun way, on an easy walk around the city with a guide. His family would like to buy interesting souvenirs during the tour.
Jaya wants to do a boat trip to see the sights. She'd also like to try the special desserts that are made in the area and get to meet the people who make them.
Ari hopes to see some art during the day, and his family want ideas for somewhere good to have lunch. They'd also love advice about where to listen to some live music.
Hua and her family want to spend the whole day exploring famous museums, seeing the most important items in each place. They'd like to explore parts of museums tourists don't usually see.
Filip and his family hope to join a small tour, where they are driven around the city. He'd like this to include some of the locations described in popular stories that were set there.

items.label: A
items.title: Fanton Tours
items.text: Come and learn about the history of shipping in the area. Our guides will show you around the harbour, and if you're lucky, you'll be there when the fishing boats come in - choose something for lunch! Booking essential as each guide can only take a maximum of ten.

items.label: B
items.title: Excel Tours
items.text: You can't leave the city without trying its famous lemon cream cake! Travel by river to one of the oldest – and smallest – family kitchens, where they still use the same 100 - year - old secret recipe. You can ask the chefs for it, but they won't tell!

items.label: C
items.title: Sally's Tours
items.text: For a different experience, join our daily minibus tours. You'll have the chance to get out and explore tiny streets or cafes you'll recognise from some well - known novels, then relax in air - conditioned comfort as guides take you to the next stop, showing you beautiful parts of the city. Groups limited to five.

items.label: D
items.title: Newton Guides
items.text: See the most famous places in the city, from the concert hall where the world's best musicians have performed, to mansions belonging to film stars and famous writers. We'll finish the tour at the historic Creative Quarter, where local artists sell their work. You can even watch them painting in their studios.

items.label: E
items.title: City Explorer
items.text: Most tourists head to the shops in the city centre, but there's more to see, like the latest attraction – a sculpture trail created especially by local artists. As you walk around the various locations, our guides can give suggestions on the best places for traditional food or where to go for fun entertainment, including live bands.

items.label: F
items.title: Billy's Tours
items.text: Whether you choose a longer bus or boat tour, or a shorter gentle tour on foot, our guides bring the past to life with amazing stories. All river tours include lunch, and walking tours include a stop in the central market, where you'll find wonderful items made here in the city.

items.label: G
items.title: Big Day Out
items.text: Discover why the city is a centre for culture and creativity. Join your guides at City Museum, with fun interactive games, then take a short walk through the park for coffee and cake by the river. You'll explore the old city with its little galleries and cafes that only locals know about!

items.label: H
items.title: GK Tours
items.text: With GK tours, jump on and off our buses from early morning until evening. Tickets give access to exhibits which aren't on public display in some attractions and also entry to a 4D cinema. There are routes to all main museums and art galleries, with lists of what you mustn't miss.

explanations.6: Matthew 想以有趣方式了解城市历史，在导游带领下轻松步行游览，家人想在 tour 中购买有趣纪念品。F 选项 “Billy's Tours” 的步行 tour 中导游用精彩故事重现过去，步行 tour 会在中央市场停留，可找到城市制造的精美物品，符合需求。原文 “walking tours include a stop in the central market, where you'll find wonderful items made here” 对应 “easy walk with guide, buy souvenirs, fun history”。
explanations.7: Jaya 想乘船游览景点，尝试当地特色甜点并结识制作者。B 选项 “Excel Tours” 乘船前往最古老的家庭厨房，品尝有百年秘方的柠檬奶油蛋糕，可与厨师交流，符合需求。原文 “travel by river to... family kitchens... try its famous lemon cream cake... ask the chefs for the recipe” 对应 “boat trip, special desserts, meet makers”。
explanations.8: Ari 想白天看艺术，家人想找好的午餐地点并获取听现场音乐的建议。E 选项 “City Explorer” 带游客参观当地艺术家创作的雕塑小径，导游会推荐传统美食和现场乐队好去处，符合需求。原文 “sculpture trail created by local artists... guides give suggestions on best places for traditional food or live bands” 对应 “see art, lunch ideas, live music advice”。
explanations.9: Hua 家人想花一整天探索著名博物馆，看每个地方最重要的物品，探索游客通常看不到的博物馆部分。H 选项 “GK Tours” 门票可进入一些景点未公开的展品，有通往所有主要博物馆和美术馆的路线，列出必看展品，符合需求。原文 “access to exhibits not on public display... routes to all main museums... lists of what you mustn't miss” 对应 “explore museums, see important items, hidden parts”。
explanations.10: Filip 家人想加入小型 tour，乘车游览城市，包括流行故事中设定的地点。C 选项 “Sally's Tours” 提供每日小巴 tour，带游客探索小说中知名的小巷和咖啡馆，团体限 5 人，符合需求。原文 “minibus tours... explore tiny streets or cafes recognised from well-known novels... groups limited to five” 对应 “small tour, driven around, story locations”。
